documents.text: A secure code review checks trust boundaries, input validation, authentication, authorization, error handling, and audit logging.
Retrieval evaluation measures whether relevant documents appear near the top. Recall at k measures coverage in the first k results. Reciprocal rank rewards the position of the first relevant result.
A model-serving API should expose liveness and readiness checks, validate input features, report prediction latency, and record the model version.
